boundary.rule: A target-day forecast must be generated only after the full previous UTC day is available and before any target-day realized variance is used.

exact_model.realized_variance: sum squared 5m close-to-close log returns on UTC day; accepted day >=270 returns
exact_model.challenger: same HAR plus target-day Tue-Sun dummies, Monday base

forward_resolution.primary_metric: cumulative mean QLIKE differential baseline minus HAR-DOW
forward_resolution.supportive: positive mean QLIKE differential on both BTC and ETH
forward_resolution.negative: negative mean QLIKE differential on either asset at primary review
forward_resolution.insufficient: fewer than 90 clean resolved target days at primary review

forbidden: No pre-2026-09-21 target outcomes may enter the forward ledger.
No tuning of weekday dummies, HAR lags, day boundary, sampling interval or rolling window.
No PnL/trading decisions are authorized by this watcher.
